title: launch-record
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

request.description: For `pipeline`: pipeline id and hash of the launch bundle. For `engine`: the argument list of the one engine start

mode.description: `run`. The mode `dry-run` writes no launch record and no run state

host.description: The host that launched: a host id, or `cli`

commentHash.description: Hash of the consumer's comment, taken before any repository text was printed

detachStrategy.description: Id of the detach strategy in use

launchNonce.description: Nonce that the lease must carry

engineExecutable.description: Path and hash of the engine executable pinned at launch

productVersion.description: Product version and CLI protocol integer of the launching CLI

protocol.description: Product version and CLI protocol integer of the launching CLI

outcome.description: Handshake outcome: `started`, `attached` or `refused`; absent until the handshake ends

refusal.description: Reason of a refusal, from the closed sets of the refusals of a launch and of `resume`

refusalFile.description: The file that changed, when the refusal is `source-changed`

resetCounts.description: The flags of the command that made the launch, so that a continuation through the runtime root can apply them

acceptSourceChange.description: The flags of the command that made the launch, so that a continuation through the runtime root can apply them

newRun.description: The flags of the command that made the launch, so that a continuation through the runtime root can apply them

resolveRoles.description: The flags of the command that made the launch, so that a continuation through the runtime root can apply them
